description: Return live catalog counts from the current snapshot. No arguments. Does not call the paid gateway. api_count and model_count are totals. apis_by_provider and apis_by_category group data APIs. models_by_modality groups model ids by primary modality: chat/reasoning, image, video, and audio. example_questions lists ready-to-ask questions in en and zh for categories the snapshot can still serve. On a first or vague message, present that intro and do not search yet. Then search_apis, get_api, and run_api only after the user confirms the live price.
